- Additionally, the European Association of Dermato-Oncology (EADO) 2024 update (citation ID: DOI:10.1016/j.ejca.2024.115153) recommends complete excision of the entire lesion with a narrow margin (1–3 mm) to perform histological diagnosis when melanoma is suspected.
